static_traits.name: Lin Siyue
static_traits.social_status: Tense relationships with colleagues(caused by high expectations and procrastination), close relationship with daughter
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no similar psychological problem history; have not received psychotherapy or counseling before
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, thoughts are coherent, cooperative, tone neutral; can describe experiences and feelings concretely

basic_info.main_problem: As long as I cannot be the best, I feel there is no need to try; this perfectionist thinking affects my motivation and self-esteem.
basic_info.core_demands: Hoping to notice and adjust when the thought 'must be the best or give up' appears, accept imperfection, set smaller and more realistic goals, and shift focus from outcomes to process.
growth_experiences: Several years ago she entered a cooking competition and did not win. She invested a lot of energy in the competition; after losing she felt 'all efforts were utterly Meaningless (devastating)', and since then she more easily has thoughts of giving up when facing situations where she may be unable to be 'truly outstanding'. Stress was initially moderate, then gradually increased on occasions of possible poor performance; these thoughts mainly appear in stressful situations where she feels she needs to 'perform exceptionally well'. She tried setting smaller goals and seeking others' approval, but with poor results.

core_beliefs: Only being the best has value / is worth trying

special_situations.event: Faces high standards and tight deadlines at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot meet the highest expectations of myself and colleagues, it equals failure and I will be looked down on
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Procrastinates and delays starting tasks to avoid possible failure and judgment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I do not do well, everyone will think I am a failure; rather than being imperfect, better not to do it

special_situations.event: When trying new recipes in the cooking field or preparing for competitions / being evaluated
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only winning or getting the best grades can prove I am excellent; otherwise efforts have no meaning
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Gives up competing or does only familiar content to reduce the risk of being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I do not get first place, all efforts are wasted and the consequences will be terrible

special_situations.event: Colleagues noticing me Missing a deadline or performing poorly at Work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Failing to meet others' expectations leads to being negated and labeled a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces communication and cooperation with colleagues, avoids feedback and evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am a failure

special_situations.event: Facing new skill Learning in a personal hobby yet struggling to excel in the short term
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot quickly become the best, it is not worth continuing to invest time and energy
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stops practicing, gives up once-loved activities
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot possibly do well; no need to continue

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized, seen as outstanding and valuable
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged as a failure, being looked down on by others (being negated)
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of failure and of being judged through avoidance and procrastination, maintaining the fragile balance of self-worth

object_relations.self_representation: A potential failure who gets negated if imperfect
object_relations.object_representation: The other party is a harsh judge / others with high expectations

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others (such as colleagues or authorities) set high standards or give evaluations/feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interpreting others' expectations as harsh judgment, believing any slight imperfection makes me a failure
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using euphemistic and defensive expressions (like 'conditions are not right now', 'better not to do it than imperfectly'), to delay or avoid tasks; calm tone but avoiding specific commitments.

manifestations: After losing a cooking competition, experiences the feeling that 'efforts are all futile'
Believing attempts have no meaning when unable to become the best

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Frequently Demanding of myself with 'must become the best' and 'imperfection equals failure'
In sessions, emphasizes results above all and neglects the process experience

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Being overly cautious or even taking no action for fear of not meeting standards

exception_events.target_problem: In situations requiring public speaking, Lin Siyue usually avoids or procrastinates for fear of not being perfect enough, experiencing marked Anxiety.
exception_events.unique_outcome: During one public speech, she did not avoid it as usual, but focused on 'doing' itself and allowed herself to be imperfect, ultimately receiving positive feedback.
exception_events.reason: Clues: she shifted attention from 'perfect results' to 'action and process', and gave herself permission to 'be imperfect', so this time she persisted and gained a better experience and feedback.

positive_force: Close relationship with daughter, having emotional support
Has had successful experiences of focusing on action in public speaking and receiving positive feedback
Willing to try setting smaller, realistic goals
Has some awareness of one's catastrophizing and perfectionist thinking
negative_force: Seeks external validation, worries about others' judgment (mind reading tendency)
Procrastination and avoidance behaviors causing impaired performance and Lowered self-esteem

target_behavior.behavior: Procrastination and avoidance appear before high-expectation tasks or tasks requiring excellent performance
antecedent: Scenes requiring evaluation or comparison with others (such as cooking, public display)
Situations of struggling to excel in the short term in hobbies or new skill Learning
target_behavior.core_reason: Driven by the core belief 'only the best have value / imperfection equals failure', accompanied by catastrophizing, mind reading and future-predicting worries, fearing being judged as a failure.
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential failure and negative evaluation, briefly reducing Anxiety and shame.
target_behavior.consequence: Missing deadlines, Decline in work performance, Interpersonal tension; motivation and Impaired self-esteem, lacking engagement in daily activities.
